laat_vaar.voor: die oproep tot gebed by die moskee
laat_vaar.na: die oproep tot gebed van die moskee
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The call comes from the mosque and is heard down the street; the preposition 'van' says that, 'by' places the listener at the mosque.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die oproep tot gebed by die moskee om die hoek' is natural Afrikaans that already identifies the mosque; the preposition swap is lateral.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Thandi has not been named in this paragraph, so 'haar' has no clear antecedent after Yusuf, his father and the people at the mosque.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: With Yusuf and his father the only other people in the sentence, 'haar' can only mean Thandi, and 'die fiets' anchors it; the story's pronoun voice should stay.

vlae.teks: In een week leer sy die hele straat van voor tot agter ken. ... Later in die jaar brand daar klein lampies op die Naidoos se voormuur. ... Teen die einde van die week ry sy die hele straat sonder om te val.
vlae.rede: The story is framed as one week, but the Divali paragraph happens 'later in die jaar' and is followed by 'teen die einde van die week'; the time frame is inconsistent, and fixing it means deciding the intended content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
